scope: Seven-player-visible-NPC-content-evidence-surfaces; existing derived sources only; no invented original text, NPC IDs or commercial server effects.

content_surfaces.supported: Taiwan v1 compiled client sends WN with five integer fields and one string; receives WN with four integer fields and one string; client-side window I/O surface is evidenced.
content_surfaces.missing: Original server dialogue text, NPC inventory/population, actual selection results and historical window layout.
content_surfaces.reopen: Authenticated v1 WN session trace paired to a named NPC, or first-generation server NPC/window script.

content_surfaces.supported: Bounded v1 disc filename scan reports no obvious standalone pet/item/skill/NPC/quest/shop master tables.
content_surfaces.missing: A filename scan cannot exclude embedded or transmitted records; complete v1 NPC/template/create/dialogue/script dataset and launch server bytes are unavailable.
content_surfaces.reopen: Official-era original downloadable NPC/create/template/script archive or independently verifiable launch-era server content.

content_surfaces.supported: Recovered25 create/template reference graph and arg-transport census are available as aggregated, non-textual evidence.
content_surfaces.missing: Thirty ambiguous template-name create references and fifteen missing secondary argument files. No original v1 membership, real-name dialogue, coordinates or raw create rows in the public derived report.
content_surfaces.reopen: Resolve recovered25 missing secondary files or obtain matching earlier create/template corpus; version-label any newly recovered row.

content_surfaces.supported: TownPeople/SignBoard/Windowman dialogue presentation and fixed-descendant Windowman routing are supported within their separate source scopes.
content_surfaces.missing: TownPeople has missing files; Windowman has four missing conff files; Windowman parser placeholders for takeitem/giveitem and warp/battle are not executable award or warp behavior in fixed callback.
content_surfaces.reopen: Recover source-matched missing 2.5 conff and TownPeople arguments; demonstrate executing callback rather than interpreting a struct placeholder.

content_surfaces.supported: Recovered25 NPCEnemy secondary arguments contain battle prompt and event/dieact structures, not original v1 enemy dialogue.
content_surfaces.missing: Specific first-generation NPCEnemy placements, creature lists, battle dialogue and quest consequences remain unverified.
content_surfaces.reopen: Find a first-generation NPCEnemy script or signed launch-version NPC battle transcript with matching server rule state.

content_surfaces.supported: Recovered25 WarpMan argument sites and spatial candidate edges exist.
content_surfaces.missing: A candidate edge does not establish valid FREE/ITEM/fee/action branch, executed server-side movement or v1 hometown/world membership.
content_surfaces.reopen: Recover same-version fully evaluated WarpMan conditions, chosen input and resulting dispatch/destination trace.

content_surfaces.supported: Two recovered25 ExChangeMan event GetItem records are independently distinguished from ordinary ItemShop purchase and from WarpMan DelItem/FREE references.
content_surfaces.missing: V1 quest chain, actual awarded item persistence, source item flags, event state durability and action-consumption semantics are not proven.
content_surfaces.reopen: Recover matching first-generation event/quest config and verified original save/relogin or uniquely attributable item award trace.

explicit_prohibitions: Never claim recovered25 NPC rows, four hometown routes or Windowman configs belong to TW1.0 or JSS1999.
Never treat WN original protocol shape as proof of NPC dialogue, quest branching or original window layout.
Never count missing argument/config files as resolved, or ambiguous templates as unambiguous references.
Never treat Windowman takeitem/giveitem/warp/battle struct placeholders as executed callbacks.
Never equate spatial WarpMan candidate edges to server-authorized travel.
Never equate ExChangeMan GetItem event grant, ordinary ItemShop purchase, WarpMan DelItem or historical durable entitlement.
Never invent server-only quest lines, item values, coordinates, rewards, dialogues or completion percentage.
Do not reopen savedata R79 absent a named material dependency.
